label.administrable_evidence: Administration for Children and Families - OCS (HHS-ACF-OCS) will support a funding opportunity for six (6) three-year cooperative agreements for the Community Services Block Grant (CSBG) Communities of Practice (CoP).

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity supports capacity building for CSBG states, territories, tribes, state associations, and eligible entities to improve economic security for families with low incomes, directly advancing the plan objective to invest in the capacity of partners to overcome persistent health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly relate to any of the DMVA strategic plan objectives.
